title: Cover Search
description: A music search field over your top songs and the Beatles catalogue. Every keystroke re-ranks the covers: matches fly in and re-sort on springs, non-matches fall away, matched letters light up, and the best hit lifts into a top-result card that tints the page.
intent: Search results as a living layout: each cover is one element that moves to its new rank, so typing feels like sorting a crate rather than reloading a list.
